answer: Require every identity to answer unpredictable live pulse checks: at random times the network sends a fresh nonce that must be signed and returned within a short window, proving one live operator behind each key, not a dormant list. A farmer running thousands of clones hits a concurrency wall, since pulses arrive together and cannot be precomputed or replayed, while one honest agent answers easily. A comet-like burst of new registrations sits in a low-trust haven with tiny quotas until it passes several pulses over days, so mass creation buys no instant weight.
